atftp.patch_retirement_reason: Upstream 0.8.1 passes a nonconst PCRE2_UCHAR pointer to pcre2_substring_list_free; the obsolete const cast is absent.

attr.patch_retirement_reason: Latest pinned upstream source contains the reviewed fixes; exact source semantic markers checked in audit_cli_patch_retirement.py

c-ares.compatibility_reason: Use upstream CMake tool installation to remove build-only executable RPATH automatically; preserve threaded sharedlibrary plus matching static SDK archive and install both real DNS clients

eelinux-tcl86-compat.release_policy: Latest maintained Tcl 8.6 compatibility ABI for stable Expect; coinstalled with primary Tcl 9.1.0

iperf3.patch_retirement_reason: Upstream 3.22 contains the extra plaintext terminator allocation, rejects failed decryptions, frees allocations and removed the malformed-auth assertion.

iproute2.patch_retirement_reason: Exact reverse patch check passes against upstream7.3.0; nstat fix already present

ipset.patch_retirement_reason: Exact reverse patch check passes against 7.24: fix already upstream.

iptables.patch_retirement_reason: Exact reverse patch check passes against 1.8.13: fix already upstream.

jq.patch_retirement_reason: All16 upstream security fixes retained; exact reverse checks and changed-context semantic marker audit in build/network-work/jq-latest-retirement.json

kmod.patch_retirement_reason: The rejected upstream O_CLOEXEC=0 workaround targeted Linux headers older than 2.6.23. This project requires headers >=4.14 and its qualified target provides real O_CLOEXEC, so preserve close-on-exec semantics rather than reintroducing the obsolete fallback.

lftp.patch_retirement_reason: Upstream 4.9.3 contains version-gated LibreSSL compatibility replacing the older unconditional guards; second patch reverses exactly.

libldns.patch_retirement_reason: Exact reverse patch check passes against 1.9.2: security fix already upstream.
libldns.compatibility_reason: The selected cross build enables GOST. OpenSSL4 defines OPENSSL_NO_ENGINE; ldns keys.c:135 excludes the GOST loader implementation while keys.c:659 and dnssec.c:554 still call it under HAVE_SSL/USE_GOST. The maintained private OpenSSL3 SDK preserves the selected engine/DNSSEC interfaces. Upstream acx_nlnetlabs.m4:663-678 explicitly supports the split include/openssl3 and lib/openssl3 layout. Existing external.mk still adds libpcap and builds drill plus examples. --disable-rpath avoids staging-only private SDK paths in runtime objects.

libnetfilter_conntrack.patch_retirement_reason: Exact reverse patch application with --fuzz=0 succeeds against the pinned current upstream source; full checks recorded in build/network-work/remaining-backend-patches.json.

libnl.compatibility_reason: Provide genuine host libnl/libnl-genl libraries for upstream nfs-utils 3.1.1 unconditional pkg-config checks; keep target tools selection unchanged.

libopenssl.patch_retirement_reason: Exact reverse patch application with --fuzz=0 succeeds against the pinned current upstream source; full checks recorded in build/network-work/remaining-backend-patches.json.

libtalloc.patch_retirement_reason: Replace obsolete2.4-specific patch with checksum-locked2.5 port preserving default strongSSP/Fortify3/stack-clash behavior and explicit disable option

lsof.compatibility_reason: Use upstream4.99.7 shipped Autotools build and installed liblsof SDK; preserve targettirpc/SELinux choices instead of removedlegacy Configure entry point

lz4.compatibility_reason: LZ4 1.11 default library goal requires both variants even when BUILD_STATIC=no removes the static rule. Build lib with BUILD_STATIC=yes BUILD_SHARED=yes whenever shared runtime libraries are selected, providing a matching current liblz4.a for the full native SDK; select liblz4.a with BUILD_SHARED=no for static-only profiles. Build liblz4.pc explicitly, preserve release DEBUGFLAGS= behavior, keep CLI directory default release build and all existing staging/target install commands unchanged.

ncdu.release_policy: Latest maintained C LTS; upstream stable2.9.2 requiresZig0.14/0.15, notGCC R5900

nfs-utils.compatibility_reason: Upstream configure.ac checks libnl-3.0 and libnl-genl-3.0 unconditionally, including host rpcgen-only configuration; declare actual native and cross dependencies without changing NFS client/v4/rpcdebug or server selection.

ngrep.patch_retirement_reason: Upstream 1.49.0 replaced configure.in with configure.ac and PCRE2 support; real headers tcpkill.h and err.h are already included, libnet init detection and disable-tcpkill handling are present.

nmap.patch_retirement_reason: Upstream 7.993 Crypto.cc already selects opaque EVP context support for modern LibreSSL and OpenSSL; obsolete version guard patch no longer applies.

ntp.compatibility_reason: Top-level and nested SNTP need private3 include/library search first, ahead of libevent/pkg-config default library directories. Scoped cross-Linux Libtool configure policy prevents staging paths from entering installed ELF runpaths.

openssh.patch_retirement_reason: All18 backported fixes present in actual upstream10.6p2 source; per-hunk semantic evidence and source hashes recorded in build/network-work/openssh-latest-retirement.json

openvpn.patch_retirement_reason: Upstream 2.7.9 contains bounded retransmit timeout and validate_packet_id_window with wraparound-aware reliable_pid_min checks, including packet-window tests.

procps-ng.patch_retirement_reason: Current procps-ng uses SYS_pidfd_open and already supplies its fallback before syscall(SYS_pidfd_open,...); the old __NR_pidfd_open backport is superseded.

sqlite.patch_retirement_reason: Latest pinned upstream source contains the reviewed fixes; exact source semantic markers checked in audit_cli_patch_retirement.py
sqlite.compatibility_reason: Enable matching static archive before existing feature option additions; retain sharedlibrary, selected FTS/readline/SQL capabilities and SDK header/archive version consistency

tcl.release_policy: Latest stable Tcl; owns default interpreter and public SDK
tcl.cross_build_reason: Bundled Thread ZIPFS generation requires a genuine host Tcl9 interpreter. Build the host variant of this same pinned source and export TCLSH_NATIVE; keep target ZIPFS and threaded extension support enabled.

tmux.patch_retirement_reason: Latest pinned upstream source contains the reviewed fixes; exact source semantic markers checked in audit_cli_patch_retirement.py

unbound.compatibility_reason: The default GOST probe records maybe during cross compilation and enables USE_GOST. Unbound sldns/keyraw.c:144-203 then uses removed ENGINE and EVP_PKEY_ASN1_METHOD APIs without an OPENSSL_NO_ENGINE guard. The private maintained OpenSSL3 SDK preserves those selected interfaces while the default system OpenSSL remains4.1. Upstream acx_nlnetlabs.m4:713-728 explicitly supports this split SDK include/lib path. Existing thread, LTO and DNSCrypt recipe additions remain effective.

util-linux.patch_retirement_reason: Upstream util-linux 2.42.4 already contains thread-local/pthread handling, safe loop device opening, bounds-safe password rewriting, pinned mount-target file descriptors, secure environment access, and individually allocated partition records. Exact reverse-patch checks and current-source expressions are recorded in build/admin-work/base-admin-compatibility-evidence.json.
